description: This source file defines a StatsController class in an ASP.NET Core Web API project, responsible for retrieving and processing grain statistics from an Orleans cluster. It includes an API endpoint for getting silo data and a record type for silo information.

classes.name: StatsController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core API controller that provides an endpoint to retrieve silo statistics from an Orleans cluster.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve and process grain statistics, returning silo data as JSON.
